assumption_register.assumption: Complete modeled contexts retain local reservation state; mapping changes can invalidate it.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Keep current and rollback rights for checkpoints, clear both in remap images.
assumption_register.stress_test: LL/save/restore/SC, disjoint per-CPU addresses, removal/readdition of reserved C memory range.; same-PC C start and unrelated host register edits after private restore

assumption_register.assumption: Decoded pending duplex work is derived from an original word and immutable ISA.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Retain that word and decode it at resume without refetching mutable guest code.
assumption_register.stress_test: Change code memory after a slot1 input exit, then restore and execute the original slot0.; reject all three non-duplex parse encodings before target mutation
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Resume executes changed code or loses the saved second slot.; normal parse values admitted as duplex

assumption_register.assumption: Deferred RAM and undelivered outputs are separate from already returned outputs.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Preserve working/initial registers, store log, output queue, finished state and HVX forwarding.
assumption_register.stress_test: Two outputs with the first already returned; RAM buffered until a returned output is acknowledged by the next step; HVX result before a suspended scalar input.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Output is repeated/lost, RAM appears early, or register/packet commit differs.

assumption_register.assumption: Preparation is bounded and cannot publish in a foreign RAM scope.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Bound collections before allocation; reject profile/phase/public conflicts before live changes; guard entry until matching publication.
assumption_register.stress_test: Oversized encoded field counts, cancellation, foreign scope, corrupt/missing final CPU, legacy projection controls.; rejected pending host edits preserve the exact context; same-PC retry resumes saved input
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Unbounded decode, early entry, partial target/RAM mutation, or loss of documented legacy behavior.

evidence_boundary: Represented software-state preservation and current Apple Silicon host qualification; instruction words checked with installed LLVM23 hexagonv68 assembler. No physical Hexagon or Intel conformance claim.
compatibility: Absent VMM private sections and C formats1/2 remain projection-only. An output returned by the existing CPU API counts as delivered. New writer version10 and producer kind9 are explicit; outer VMM framing is unchanged.
known_independent_native_failure: The earlier complete ignored native CPU-profile module retains the streaming FPSR reentry failure. This Hexagon group does not repair or rerun that module.
unrun: Physical Intel HVF/KVM qualification and Intel cross compilation

root_execution_policy.reason: Complete unfiltered owning binary on verified 16-core/128-GiB host; no exclusions or global setting changes.
root_execution_policy.ignored_policy: Default Rust harness ignored policy; selected actual native file case separately includes ignored.

fixture_extension: The original one-CPU red LL/SC witness is retained. Final two/four-CPU cases use disjoint addresses and do not assert behavior under cross-CPU interference.
complexity: For C CPUs, B encoded bytes and N bounded collection entries, framing/decode and state transfer take O(C+B+N) time and O(B+N) auxiliary space, excluding memory-map admission. Range admission additionally incurs the map lookup/region visitation cost for each reservation/store. RAM data transfer is separately O(R) bytes. No measured performance claim.
